name: Paru Reclamation
description: Reclaim the abandoned streets of Paru. Nature has taken back what civilization left behind.

dialog.speaker: Scavenger
dialog.text: Look at this place. Plumbing, wiring, buildings taller than anything we've got. And it's all just... left here.

dialog.speaker: Scavenger
dialog.text: How does a civilization that can build all this just disappear? What could do that?
